scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF peer inventory around a potential AC1015-only DWG reader, establish lineage limits for same-project repositories, and refine comparator admission without increasing normal validation cost.

method.kind: Primary-source repository and package-documentation review with local plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing peer independence, composed comparison, and validation-cadence rules
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing dxf-rs, undxf, ezdwg, LibreDWG, and wrapper-lineage entries
method.limitations: Repository READMEs and package metadata identify candidate scope only. No immutable lib_opencad revision or reproducible build was selected, no source was inspected or executed, and no specific AC1015 file behavior was observed. Mutable branch documentation is not treated as release/runtime qualification.

evidence.topic: A current lib_opencad successor advertises a narrow AC1015 route
observed: The README describes the library as under development and says that only DWG R2000 is currently supported.
The project is a candidate for an optional AC1015 comparison if an exact revision and runnable route are established.
doesNotEstablish: Entity/object completeness, graph ownership, error recovery, output support, a released binary, or actual behavior on a specific drawing.
AC1015 version-wide support or any ACIS/3D semantic support.
evidence.planUse: Keep as an optional AC1015-only structural candidate, gated on an active question, immutable source pin, license/build review, and source-generated expected manifest; do not add it to per-slice validation.

evidence.topic: The original libopencad repository is explicitly superseded
observed: The repository says it is abandoned and points to nextgis-borsch/lib_opencad as the repository to use.
Its historical README describes only limited R15 basic-geometry read coverage and explicit missing areas.
doesNotEstablish: Whether the successor retains any particular old limitation or issue.
evidence.planUse: Do not treat the abandoned repository as a current runtime candidate; verify inherited-risk hypotheses against the successor before turning them into local test cases.

evidence.topic: codelibs/libdxfrw is not an independent parser lineage
observed: Its project documentation identifies the library as libdxfrw, version 0.6.3, and describes the established ASCII/binary DXF plus R14–V2015 DWG-reader family.
doesNotEstablish: That every file or current downstream patch is identical to this checkout.
evidence.planUse: Use only for a concrete downstream source-delta question; do not count it as an independent DWG/DXF semantic vote.

evidence.topic: gdsestimating/dxf-parser is limited to an optional ASCII 2D projection role
observed: The README accepts DXF text and describes a JavaScript object-model parser with most 2D entities.
The documented unsupported set includes 3DSolids and less-common objects/entities; package metadata identifies version 1.1.2.
doesNotEstablish: Binary DXF, DWG, complete object/reference preservation, ACIS carrier support, or 3D solid semantics.
That the mutable repository source is identical to the published package artifact.
evidence.planUse: At most a non-gating ASCII 2D projection diagnostic at an existing composed checkpoint; do not install it or add a routine test/dependency.

readinessRefinement: Use lib_opencad only as an optional, exact-pinned AC1015 structural peer when an active AC1015 question warrants the extra build cost.
Do not count abandoned predecessors, downstream libdxfrw repositories, or wrappers as independent parser lineages.
Constrain gdsestimating/dxf-parser to optional ASCII 2D projection diagnostics; exclude binary DXF, DWG, and ACIS/3D claims.
Keep peer builds and runtime checks at the existing composed checkpoint; implementation slices continue with local generated fast tests and specification-backed work.
